findings.title: Potential XSS (Angular Sanitizer Bypass)
findings.description: Value is marked as trusted HTML, so Angular renders it without sanitizing
context: ⚠ No HTML encoding or sanitization visible
✓ URL / storage value read nearby (attacker-controllable in the browser)
⚠ Non-executed code snippet (training/fixture file, not run by the app)
findings.remediation: Don't mark untrusted data as trusted. Render it as text ({{ value }} in Angular, {value} in React); if it must contain HTML, sanitize it first: sanitizer.bypassSecurityTrustHtml(DOMPurify.sanitize(value)) / dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: DOMPurify.sanitize(value) }}.
